title: Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties IPO
summary: Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties IPO is a ₹1,000 crore book-built issue, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties IPO has a total issue size of ₹1000 Crores and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: IIFL Capital Services Ltd, JM Financial Ltd

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

The company was incorporated in 2000 and currently, it is one of the leading developers of real estate properties in North India, especially in the city of Delhi-NCR and tier II/III cities with its ongoing and completed projects in over 20 cities. · Besides, as of March 31, 2025, the Company has 19 Ongoing Projects amounting to a Saleable Area of 7.24 msf and 18 Forthcoming Projects amounting to a Saleable Area of 7.37 msf, in 14 cities. · Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties is located in many cities across North India including cities like Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida and Bareilly in the state of Uttar Pradesh; Sohna, Gurugram, Panipat, Sonipat and Panchkula in Haryana; Jalandhar and Ludhiana in Punjab; Sirmaur in Himachal Pradesh; Neemrana in Rajasthan and Rudrapur and Narendra Nagar in Uttarakhand. · Amongst the company's Ongoing Projects, the following two are company current ventures: (i) Eldeco Fairway Reserve in Sector 80, Gurugram; and (ii) Eldeco La Vida Bella in Greater Noida that has a good connection via the Noida-Greater Noida Link Road. · As of March 31, 2025, Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties had 304 employees
Pankaj Bajaj, Bandana Kohli are the company's promoters of Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties.
